speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episode of loss of consciousness. I also have Regained consciousness quickly without confusion, No urinary incontinence, No bite marks or injuries.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope (a form of vasovagal syncope).

The clinical picture of fainting immediately after urinating, without prodromal symptoms like chest pain or significant lightheadedness upon standing, combined with negative cardiac and abdominal imaging, is classic for this condition. The rapid recovery without confusion further supports a benign neurogenic etiology rather than a cardiac arrhythmia or structural injury.
